reports.name: Strategy

snapshot.holdings: 846,000 BTC (as of Sept 20, 2026), acquired for $63.80B at avg $75,416/BTC

reports.email_summary: MSTR's mNAV climbs to a 3-month high and unrealized BTC losses flip to ~$8-9B in gains as Bitcoin tops $85K.
reports.bottom_line: No new capital-markets or governance items beyond already-reported BTC buys and STRC buybacks; the incremental news is a BTC-price-driven improvement in mNAV and unrealized P&L that strengthens the balance sheet without new dilution. Thesis remains intact but unchanged mechanically — the gains are mark-to-market, not from accretive per-share BTC growth this week.
source_conflicts: Unrealized profit estimates vary across sources ($8B, $8.59B, $8.75B, $8.9B, $9B) depending on exact BTC price snapshot used and timing of the article; all describe the same directional swing from a prior ~$10-13B unrealized loss.

updates.headline: MSTR mNAV climbs to 1.17x, highest since June
updates.what_happened: Strategy's mNAV multiple rose to 1.17x, meaning investors are paying $1.17 for every $1 of BTC held, as MSTR stock closed at $168 on September 21, its highest close since May 15. The rise came after the stock added roughly $32 billion in market value over three months, a figure Strategy itself highlighted on X.
updates.thesis_fit: A rising mNAV premium improves the economics of any future ATM/equity issuance for BTC purchases, directly supporting the 'financing priced attractively vs mNAV' checklist item.

updates.headline: Unrealized BTC loss flips to ~$8-9B gain
updates.what_happened: Strategy's 846,000 BTC holdings swung from an unrealized loss of roughly $10-13B earlier this year to an unrealized gain of approximately $8-9 billion as Bitcoin rallied above $85,000. The reversal follows an $8.2 billion net loss reported for Q2 2026 driven largely by unrealized BTC losses.
updates.thesis_fit: Improves BTC NAV coverage and eases pressure on the STRC/preferred credit stack, though it is purely price-driven rather than from per-share BTC accretion this week.

reports.name: Metaplanet

snapshot.holdings: 43,000 BTC (last disclosed as of June 30, 2026 quarterly update; no new purchase reported since)

reports.email_summary: No new material Metaplanet disclosures in the past 3 days; stock trades near 243 yen with mNAV below 1.0x amid unresolved governance overhang.
reports.bottom_line: No fresh primary-source filings emerged in the September 20-23 window beyond items already reported; the stock continues to trade at a discount to BTC NAV (~0.77x EV-based mNAV) while the MSCI non-operating-company consultation (closes Sept 30, decision Oct 16) and unresolved Series 10/MMXX governance questions remain the dominant overhangs. Net effect on thesis is unchanged from prior sweep — watch for the Q3 BTC purchase disclosure and MSCI outcome as the next catalysts.
source_conflicts: Bitcointreasuries.net shows two different mNAV readings as of ~Sept 21, 2026 (EV-based 0.77x vs. Basic 0.57x); report uses the EV-based figure but the gap should be reconciled against the dashboard's own methodology.

reports.name: Asset Entities / Strive
reports.email_summary: TD Cowen hikes ASST price target to $44 on faster BTC accumulation; no new dilution or governance red flags this window.
reports.bottom_line: The only new development this window is a sell-side price target increase reinforcing the accumulation-driven bull case already priced into recent 8-Ks; no new financing, dilution, or governance issues emerged beyond items already reported.
source_conflicts: Intraday ASST price quotes on 2026-09-22 varied slightly across sources ($29.68 on Robinhood vs. $29.97 on Investing.com vs. $29.66 on Yahoo real-time), likely reflecting different snapshot times rather than a data conflict.

mNAV figures (1.25x basic / 1.68x diluted per bitcointreasuries.net) are dated Sep 14, 2026 and predate the latest 1,355 BTC purchase and subsequent share price rally, so current mNAV is likely different and should be treated as stale.

updates.headline: TD Cowen raises ASST price target to $44 from $32
updates.what_happened: TD Cowen analysts Lance Vitanza and Jonnathan Navarrete lifted their price target on ASST, citing bitcoin accumulation that has outpaced their model and stronger growth in bitcoin held per fully diluted share. The firm now projects Strive will end 2026 with 32,105 BTC (up from a prior 27,156 estimate) and raised its full-year BTC Yield forecast from 54.1% to 70.1%.
updates.thesis_fit: A raised sell-side target grounded in accelerating BTC-per-share growth supports the thesis that Strive can build a durable, market-trusted Bitcoin-per-share story.

updates.headline: Strive CEO discusses bitcoin outlook on Bloomberg Crypto
updates.what_happened: Strive Chairman/CEO Matt Cole appeared on Bloomberg Crypto to discuss the broader digital-asset market, which had reclaimed roughly $3 trillion in value amid a bitcoin rally, alongside growing use of leveraged perpetual futures by traders. The segment was general market commentary rather than a company-specific disclosure.
updates.thesis_fit: Routine media commentary from management with no new treasury, financing, or governance information; does not change the thesis.

reports.name: BitMine Immersion

snapshot.holdings: 5,983,940 ETH (~4.9% of ETH supply); 212 BTC; $17.1B total crypto+cash+moonshots

reports.email_summary: No new material BitMine developments beyond already-reported weekly ETH treasury update and Tom Lee commentary.
reports.bottom_line: The past three days brought only routine continuation of previously reported items (5.98M ETH holdings, Korea Blockchain Week keynote, institutional-underweight commentary) with no new financing, governance, or custody disclosures. Thesis remains unchanged pending BitMine's next weekly 8-K or any dilution/financing news.

sector.bottom_line: The dominant sector-wide overhang remains MSCI's live consultation on excluding Bitcoin/digital-asset treasury companies from its Global Investable Market Indexes, with the comment window closing September 30 and results due October 16, 2026, while regulators continue advancing custody and market-structure rules in the wake of the stalled CLARITY Act.

updates.headline: MSCI index-exclusion consultation for Bitcoin treasuries nears close
updates.what_happened: MSCI's renewed consultation would classify certain 'non-operating' companies — explicitly naming Strategy and Metaplanet based on a May 2026 simulation, with uranium holder Yellow Cake also swept in — as ineligible for its Global Investable Market Indexes. Public feedback closes September 30, 2026, with results expected October 16, and any changes would take effect in the November 2026 index review, potentially forcing passive-fund selling.

updates.headline: SEC signals crypto custody rulemaking proceeding despite CLARITY stall
updates.what_happened: Following the Senate's failure to advance the CLARITY Act, SEC Chair Paul Atkins publicly reiterated that the agency will act on crypto market structure 'with or without legislation,' with a crypto custody rule proposal — sent to OMB in late August — cited as a near-term priority alongside continuing work on Regulation Crypto Assets.
